about: The toy trace of the original proposal (one layer, one request). Used by Plate III.7 (HiSparse) and IV.5 (kv-blockdiff). Positions are token positions 0..15; blocks have b = 4 tokens (block j holds 4j..4j+3).

expected.notes: Resolve rule (HiSparse): misses evict the oldest resident entry not selected at this step; then hits are moved to the newest end, in the order of the selection list. Residency rule (kv-blockdiff toy): after each step keep the dictionaries of the n_D blocks with the most entries in the hot cache.
